name: abu-bakr-first-caliph
description: After the Prophet's death, the community's leaders chose his close companion Abu Bakr as its first successor.

name: rashidun-victory-nahavand
description: A decisive victory over the Sasanian army under Caliph Umar left the Persian heartland open to conquest.

name: battle-of-the-camel-caliph-ali
description: The first civil war among Muslims began as Caliph Ali's forces defeated an army led by Aisha outside Basra.

name: great-mosque-damascus-begun
description: An Umayyad caliph started a vast mosque on the site of a Christian basilica in his capital.

name: samarra-founded-by-mutasim
description: An Abbasid caliph moved his court and Turkish guards to a new palace city north of Baghdad.

name: cordoba-caliphate-proclaimed
description: The emir of Cordoba took the title of caliph, creating a third rival caliphate in the Muslim world.

name: madinat-al-zahra-begun
description: The Cordoban caliph began a royal palace city outside his capital to display the power of his new caliphate.

name: buyids-seize-baghdad
description: A Persian dynasty entered the capital and reduced the Abbasid caliph to a figurehead under their control.

name: saladin-ends-fatimid-caliphate
description: Saladin had the sermon read in the name of the Abbasid caliph, ending Shia caliphal rule in Egypt.

name: khilafat-movement-india
description: Indian Muslims launched a mass campaign to defend the Ottoman caliph's position after the First World War.
